newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Portugal CPI seen 0.1-0.2 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Portugal CPI seen 0.1-0.2 pct in March.

text.p: Portugal's consumer price index (CPI) is expected to have risen 0.1-0.2 percent month-on-month in March, compared with a 0.2 percent rise in February, according to a Reuter poll of six analysts on Tuesday.
The National Statistics Institute (INE) will release the official figures later on Tuesday.
A monthly rate of 0.1-0.2 percent would give a year-on-year increase of 2.6-2.7 percent, down from 2.9 percent in February, while the rolling 12-month average would remain unchanged at 3.2 percent.
In March 1996, the monthly rate was 0.4 percent, the year-on-year 2.4 percent and the average rate 3.6 percent.
